# apply-aesthetic

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use for a requested visual direction. Translate the actual brief into existing
tokens, typography, spacing, and components while preserving accessibility.
The upstream 138-system library is intentionally absent; do not promise or
automatically fetch its recipes. Never invent charts or statistics for balance.
Verify the changed surface under frontend-design.
